programme.title: iCarly: Det holder
programme.desc: Mrs Benson oppdager Sam og Freddies forhold etter at Gibby - som nå er mål for Sams hevn - har lagt planer om å splitte dem. Kommer Carly til å slåss for Sam og Freddie, eller hjelpe Gibby med å få dem til å gå fra hverandre?

programme.title: iCarly: Jeg elsker deg
programme.desc: Carly ber Sam og Freddie om å prøve hverandres yndlingshobbier. I mens treffer Spencer på sin gamle barnevakt og ber henne ut på middag. Etter at de har falt inn i sine gamle roller igjen, kommer de fortsatt til å kunne være sammen?

programme.title: iCarly: iQ
programme.desc: Carly vil imponere en ny fyr ved å prøve å virke smartere enn hun er. Og gjengen prøver å finne et nytt sted å bo til T-Bo, etter at han har blitt kastet ut av Groovy Smoothie.

programme.title: iCarly: Møtet med førstedamen
programme.desc: Et føderalt bureau begynner å undersøke iCarly-gjengen etter at de hacker seg inn på et sikkerhetsnettverk for å holde nettfødselsdag for Carlys far. Gjestestjerne - Michelle Obama.

programme.title: iCarly: Billetten
programme.desc: Gjengen, minus Carly, tar med Sam til Canadian Fat Cake-fabrikken, men oppdager så at Sam ikke får komme tilbake inn i USA. I mens får Carly bekymringer i badekaret når hun gjør seg klar til daten sin.

programme.title: iCarly: Turen til Yakima
programme.desc: Etter å ha blitt disset i et intervju om iCarly, prøver Freddie å vise sin kreative side gjennom å webb-sende iCarly i 3D. Spencer ansetter en assistent som han ikke har råd til å betale.

programme.title: iCarly: Tabber
programme.desc: Christopher Cane, skuespilleren som spiller Rex on Victorious, venner tilbake som vert i et dyptgående intervju med stjernerne fra iCarly og viser deres supergøyale tabber og bortklipte scener. Gjestestjerne: Rex fra Victorious

programme.title: iCarly: Fortsatt like gal
programme.desc: Ettr å ha fått beskjed om at Nora Dershlit blir løslatt fra fengselet, ser iCarly-gjengen på hva de kan gjøre for å holde sin gamle kidnapper bak lås og slå. Imens oppdager Freddies mor den virkelige T-Bo.

programme.title: iCarly: iCarly møter One Direction
programme.desc: Carly får en smittsom sykdom og kommer til å smitte et medlem i bandet One Direction. I mens skal Spencer trene en liten jente som ikke kan fordra å morsjonere.

programme.title: iCarly: Restauranten
programme.desc: Gibby åpner en hemmelig restaurant i skolens kjeller med Sams hjelp. Og Spencer designer en sikkerhetsrobot til hjemmebruk, som plutselig mister fokus helt.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Plan 10
programme.desc: Raphs impulsivitet sender ham i store problemer når han ved et uhell skader en maskin som tvinger ham til å bytte hjerne med Kraang.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Hevnen er min
programme.desc: Leo går bak ryggen på Splinter når han forsøker å redde Karai. Hennes ønske om hevn mot Shredder skaper store konsekvenser for alle sammen.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: En spøkelseshistorie fra Chinatown
programme.desc: Donnie blir mer og mer sjalu på April og Caseys forhold. April blir kidnappet av en ond ånd som vil tappe April for krefter.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Reisen til Dimensjon X
programme.desc: Hjemme roter Mikey til alt mulig, men når Turtles drar til den merkelige Dimensjon X er han den eneste som skjønner seg på stedet.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Invasjonen: Del 1
programme.desc: Leo og Donnie er uenige om hvordan de skal stoppe Kraangs invasjon. Når Leo gjør en fatal feil blir han separert fra laget og Donnie må ta over som leder.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Invasjonen: Del 2
programme.desc: Leo og Donnie er uenige om hvordan de skal stoppe Kraangs invasjon. Når Leo gjør en fatal feil blir han separert fra laget og Donnie må ta over som leder.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: I skogen
programme.desc: Laget må innse at det er en mulighet for at Leo ikke vil bli bedre. Og mens ting blir verre blir Raph fanget av en ny mutant.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: En fot for stor
programme.desc: Turtles oppdager Bigfoot i skogen, og Donnie blir venn med den. Han insisterer på at de må beskytte den mot en jeger som er etter den.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Begravde hemmeligheter

programme.desc: Kennys foreldre blir arrestert og han plasseres i fosterhjem - så nå er Cartman det fattigste barnet på skolen! I mellomtiden kommer en mystisk figur fra fortiden tilbake.

programme.title: South Park: Mecha Streisand
programme.desc: Cartman og Kyle krangler om et magisk triangel som kan forvandle Barbra Streisand til et fryktelig monster.

programme.title: South Park: Mysterion reiser seg
programme.desc: Ført an av 'Mysterion', jobber 'Coon' og vennene hans med å hjelpe folk i Gulfen. Og 'Coon' er ute etter hevn.

programme.title: South Park: Kyllingelskeren
programme.desc: Barbrady ber guttene om hjelp til å løse en sak, og Cartman lar seg rive med av sin nye autoritet.

programme.title: South Park: Cartman får en analundersøkelse
programme.desc: Cartman drømmer at han møter et romvesen, men de andre guttene er sikre på at drømmen var virkelighet.

programme.title: South Park: En stige til himmelen
programme.desc: Guttene bryter seg inn for å stjele urnen med Kennys aske.

programme.title: South Park: Hyllusinasjoner
programme.desc: De hysteriske foreldrene i South Park får enda en grunn til panikk når 'cheesing' blir poplært blant barna.

programme.title: South Park: Selvantenning
programme.desc: Innbyggerne i South Park begynner å eksplodere uten forvarsel. Stans far tar saken.

programme.title: South Park: Den skumle fisken
programme.desc: Sharon Marshs tante Flo har gaver til Shelly og Stan. Shelly får et flott stereoanlegg, mens Stan får en skummel fisk.

programme.title: South Park: Kassebilderby
programme.desc: Randy og Stan oppdager uforvarende warphastighet, så nå kan Jorden bli opptatt i Det galaktiske planetforbund, men en romgangster truer med å ødelegge alt.

programme.title: South Park: Rumpeburgere
programme.desc: Stans eksistensielle livskrise fortsetter, og Cartman går inn i burgerbransjen med en superspesiell hemmelig ingrediens.

programme.title: South Park: Informativ mordporno
programme.desc: Gutta bruker spillet Minecraft for å prøve å forhindre at foreldrene deres skader hverandre.

programme.title: South Park: Penger og gull
programme.desc: Stan bestefar kjøper et overpriset smykke til ham fra J & G handelsnettverk. Stan innser at han må redde sårbare seniorer fra handelsnettverk. Cartman starter sitt eget handelsnettverk når han ser hvor godt J & G handlenettverks taktikk fungerer.

programme.title: South Park: Asspen
programme.desc: Når gutta reiser til Aspen for å stå på ski for første gang, legger Stan seg ut med lokalbefolkningen og blir utfordret til et løp.

programme.title: South Park: Freemium er ikke gratis

programme.title: South Park: Skogsdyrenes jul

programme.title: South Park: South Parks fantastiske påskespesial
programme.desc: Stan vil finne opprinnelsen til malte påskeegg og oppdager en hemmelighet om den katolske kirken.

programme.title: South Park: Du har null venner
programme.desc: Mot bedre vitende, blir Stan med på Facebook og blir en sosialt nettworkende 'juggernaut', noe som forårsaker at han selv blir sugd inn i websiden.

programme.title: iCarly: Restauranten
programme.desc: Gibby åpner en hemmelig restaurant i skolens kjeller med Sams hjelp. Og Spencer designer en sikkerhetsrobot til hjemmebruk, som plutselig mister fokus helt.

programme.title: iCarly: Aprilsnarr
programme.desc: I dette spesielle aprilsnarr-avsnittet blir Carly og Spencer satt på gaten, så gjengen sitter og tenker tilbake på sin tid i Bushwell Plaza. Men minnene deres stemmer kanskje ikke alltid helt med hvordan vi husker hendelsene.

programme.title: iCarly: Dårlig stemning i butikken
programme.desc: Freddies nye drømmejobb i Pear Store blir et mareritt når Sam også blir ansatt. Imens prøver Carly å bli inviteret ut av en fra Pear Store, og Spencer må melde seg til frivillig jobb på den lokale brannstasjonen.

programme.title: iCarly: Halloween
programme.desc: iCarly-gjengen holder en "Halfoween"-fest, for de syns at det skal være Halloween to ganger i året. Men da en forkledd gjest spiller Carly og vennene et puss, blir festen litt for vill.

programme.title: iCarly: Chucks lillebror
programme.desc: Et sinna barn ønsker inderlig å hevne seg, men målskiven Spencer prøver iherdig å stoppe ham. Gibby blir knust når hans nye lekelaserpistol går i stykker, men blir fra seg av henrykkelse når Freddies reparsjion gir den overraskende krefter.

programme.title: iCarly: Utestengt
programme.desc: Når Carly bannlyser T-Bo fra hennes og Spencers hjem, hevner han seg ved å ikke slippe Carly inn på Groovy Smoothie. Imens oppdager Freddie og Gibby at det fins mange fordeler ved å spille i band...og også et par ulemper.

programme.title: iCarly: Turen til Las Vegas
programme.desc: Når Sam får vite at moren hennes er i fengsel i Vegas, bestemmer gjengen seg for å ta sine mest verdifulle eiendeler, kjøre til Vegas og pantsette dem - så de får nok penger til å betale borgen for henne. Gjesteartister: History Channels PAWN STARS.

programme.title: iCarly: Nattsynbrillene
programme.desc: Sams venn kommer ut av ungdomsfengselet, og Sam advarer alle om å holde seg unna, men Carly hører ikke etter og havner på dypt vann. Hjemme i leiligheten finner Spencer noen nattsynbriller.

programme.title: iCarly: Verden er rystet del 1
programme.desc: Jimmy Fallon inviterer iCarly-gjengen til å opptre live i programmet sitt i New York. De elsker New York og er kjempeglade for å være med i programmet, men alt kan skje på live tv.

programme.title: iCarly: Verden er rystet del 2
programme.desc: Jimmy Fallon inviterer iCarly-gjengen til å opptre live i programmet sitt i New York, men en stor klesmiss fra Gibby betyr store problemer for nettshowets fremtid.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: I drømme
programme.desc: Vesener som lever på drømmer fanger Turtles i deres egne drømmer, mens April og Casey må finne en måte å vekke dem på.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Kappløp med demonen
programme.desc: Casey og Donnie bonder mens de bygger Caseys nye hot rod, men det nye vennskapet deres settes på prøve av Farts Demonen, en bil-mutant som terroriserer veien.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Kimærens øyne
programme.desc: Når Casey, Raph, Mikey og Donnie blir fanget av en ny mutant, må både April og Leo overvinne sine fysiske restriksjoner for å redde dem.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Åndelig oppdrag
programme.desc: Leo tar med Turtles for å trene på et avansert ninja-rituale i skogen, der de må overvinne svakhetene sine og stå opp mot sine største fiender for å bli ekte ninjaer.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Tilbake til New York
programme.desc: Turtles reiser tilbake til byen for å søke etter Splinter. Der oppdager de at byen flyter over av Kraang.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Slangejakt
programme.desc: Samtidig som Turtles leter etter Karai, må de ta seg av en by stappfull av Kraangdroider, Zeck og Steranko, som jakter på Karai for egen vinning.

programme.desc: Innan finalparet koras har det blivit dags att stå till svars för sina synder i en sista grillning. Ett par kommer stå som segrare och göra upp om prissumman på en halv miljon kronor i kulceremonin!

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 16
programme.desc: Vem ska sova med vem och hur låter egentligen en hare? Många frågor cirkulerar på hotellet och äntligen får gästerna möjlighet att ställa varandra mot väggen i säsongens första Pandoras Ask.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 16
programme.desc: Svek och lögner som avslöjats är uppladdningen inför kvällens Pandoras Ask, som slutar i kaos. Dessutom har datorn blivit hackad! Vilka filer har blivit raderade och måste checka ut från hotellet?

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 16
programme.desc: Domaren fortsätter dela ut guldtröjor och det har blivit dags för finalmatch med immunitet i potten. Pandoras Ask blir en hetsig historia, och vilka har egentligen skrivit de sista frågorna?

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 16
programme.desc: Det är upp till bevis på Pandoras Ask, kommer den planerade lögnen att avslöjas? Två medium ska utses för att väcka ett av spökena till liv, men vilka som ska få chansen är inte helt självklart.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 17
programme.desc: Vem är snyggast? Vem spelar dubbelt? Och vem är sugen på vem? Gästerna ställs mot väggen i säsongens första Pandoras Ask.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 17
programme.desc: En vildhingst checkar in på hotellet, men vem av tjejerna i stallet kommer lyckas tämja honom? Pennorna vässas inför Pandoras Ask.

programme.desc: Tennessee's first maximum security prison was a glorified slave labor camp that treated inmates as single use units of labor. Miners were left to die during cave-ins, and the facility was known as "the end of the line."

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Åland (Part 2)
programme.desc: Tareq goes back to Åland to explore more of this island territory. Tareq finds a chef setting up a huge food village, sees forts left over from various invaders over the centuries, and learns about beer being recreated from 200 year old DNA.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Tornedalen
programme.desc: There are not many places like Tornedalen. A rushing river has provided for locals for centuries, and the very fertile land has yielded amazing crops for centuries.Tareq explores the traditions and the food that are part of the short summer season.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: North Jutland
programme.desc: At the northern-most part of Denmark, you are always close to raw, beautiful nature, and incredible sunlight that has drawn artists here for over 100 years. Tareq visits a salt maker using medieval techniques and experiences the magic light of Skagen.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: East Denmark
programme.desc: East Denmark contains some of Denmark’s most fertile lands, and many traditional farmers are converting to organic production and winning awards for their cheeses and wine. Tareq bikes through an area of limestone cliffs and Viking ships.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Kristianstad
programme.desc: Located in Sweden’s south, beautiful Kristianstad is a 400-year old town surrounded by the ocean, fertile farmland and protected wetlands to aid the environment. Tareq makes his own chocolate and learns all about the art of eel-fishing.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Southwest Jutland
programme.desc: Tareq visits Sydvestjylland – a unique area in Denmark filled with endless contrasts. Many food innovators are using the surrounding environment to take old traditions and apply them to the 21st century.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Nynäshamn
programme.desc: Sunny Nynäshamn is a resort town close to Stockholm, but there is more here than the sea. Tareq meets a prize-winning chocolate maker using ingredients from her garden, visits a thriving local food market, and gets a lesson in how to smoke fish.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Røros
programme.desc: Born as a mining town in the 17th century, Røros is now a center for local and organic food producers. Tareq tries dairy products which Michelin-starred chefs swear by, goes skiing and sledding around Røros many hilly streets

programme.title: Nathan For You
programme.desc: Ett hotell försöker locka sexuellt aktiva föräldrar, en reseagent får lära sig tjäna pengar på sina äldre kunder, och Nathan vet hur man aldrig kommer för sent.

programme.title: Nathan For You: Nail Salon / Fun
programme.desc: En plan för att hindra att nagellack spricker går fel, och Nathan tar itu med sin värsta personlighetsbrist.

programme.title: Högspänning med Erik Ekstrand: Avsnitt 105
programme.desc: Conny och Omid tar hjälp av en helikopter för att få en ny elledning på plats, men både väder och vind ställer till det rejält. I Stockholm tvingas David och Alexander jobba sent i mörker och kyla.

programme.title: Högspänning med Erik Ekstrand: Avsnitt 106
programme.desc: Blöt tung snö har gjort flera hushåll strömlösa, enda sättet för Anton och Anders att lösa problemet är att spränga bort trädet. Niclas och Simon ska utföra ett rutinarbete som inte alls går som planerat.

programme.title: Högspänning med Erik Ekstrand: Avsnitt 107
programme.desc: På Sveriges största vindkraftspark till havs, har Clayton och Stefan fått ett brådskande larm där plötsligt något går fel, en mil från fastlandet.

programme.title: Högspänning med Erik Ekstrand: Avsnitt 108
programme.desc: Utanför Arjeplog lagar Sture och hans brorson Erik gatubelysningen, men den djupa snön ställer till med problem. Niclas och Simon genomför en riktig balansakt när de kämpar för att laga en elledning.

programme.title: Högspänning med Erik Ekstrand: Avsnitt 109
programme.desc: Larmet går på ett av vindkraftverken i Lillgrund. Det är mörkt och blåsigt när Stefan och Clayton skyndar sig ut med båten för att fixa problemet. Jonna utbildar sig för att gå med i insatsstyrkan.

programme.title: The Hound of the Baskervilles
programme.desc: Sherlock Holmes and Dr Watson investigate the legend of a supernatural hound, a beast that may be stalking a young heir on the fog-shrouded moorland that makes up his estate.

programme.title: The Adventures of Sherlock Holmes
programme.desc: This follow up to THE HOUND OF THE BASKERVILLES returns Basil Rathbone as Sherlock Holmes and Nigel Bruce as Dr. John Watson, now attempting to foil their archenemy Professor Moriarty, who targets a family and plots the theft of the Crown Jewels.

programme.title: The Pearl of Death
programme.desc: When a valuable pearl with a sinister reputation is stolen, Sherlock Holmes must investigate its link to a series of brutal murders.

programme.title: The Scarlet Claw
programme.desc: When a gentlewoman is found dead with her throat torn out, the villagers blame a supernatural monster. But Sherlock Holmes, who gets drawn into the case from nearby Quebec, suspects a human murderer.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 16
programme.desc: Gästerna väcks upp av kyrkklockor efter nattens svensexa. Det är bröllopsdag i paradiset och gåvor ska delas ut till de blivande äkta makarna. Men finns det gåvor till alla par?

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 16
programme.desc: Äktenskapsbryterskan har checkat in på hotellet för att röra om i grytan och bröllopsmiddagen blir en jobbig tillställning. Smekmånaden blir inte heller en dans på rosor när en skilsmässa hotar.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 16
programme.desc: Den borttappade bröllopsgåvan har dykt upp på hotellet men vem är den adresserad till? Och hur kommer det att påverka kvällens parceremoni? Det börjar lukta trubbel i paradiset när till och med de mest etablerade paren börjar tvivla på varandra.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 17
programme.desc: Två fresterskor checkar in och gör två av dom andra tjejerna till singlar. Dessutom kommer en av singlarna att behöva checka ut från hotellet redan samma kväll.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 17
programme.desc: Kyrkklockorna ringer och det är dags för bröllop. En förlovning kommer dock att brytas och ytterligare en hjärtekrossad tjej kommer tvingas lämna hotellet.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 5
programme.desc: Tjejerna checkar in men lyckan byts snart i allvar. Det är dags för killarna att göra entré och genast måste alla bedöma varandra. Vem vill ha vem, och vem går att lita på?

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 17
programme.desc: Det är dags för eleverna att grilla varandra i ett klassråd. Konflikter och hemligheter puttrar upp till ytan och sprider nervositet. En åtråvärd immunitet står även på spel inför slutprovet.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 17
programme.desc: Skolveckan lider mot sitt slut och en kille står i riskzonen att åka hem, och ett rykte sprids som en löpeld bland deltagarna. Vem, eller vilka, kan inte lita på sin partner i veckans parceremoni?

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 18
programme.desc: Det ringer in till skolvecka på hotellet och det är dags för eleverna på Paradise High att visa sina kunskaper. Men, ska man tänka på sin pakt eller på sig själv? Och vad rimmar egentligen på netto?

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 18
programme.desc: Tillit växer fram i oväntade allianser, och på andra håll gror svartsjukan. Alla medel verkar vara tillåtna när det gäller att slå in kilar hos paren i motsatt pakt. Dessutom checkar balens kung in.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 18
programme.desc: Starka känslor fortsätter dominera på hotellet och för flera av paren är det svårt att förstå varandra. Men vad vet egentligen killarna om tjejer? Ett kunskapsprov i kvinnlig anatomi står på schemat.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 18
programme.desc: I kvällens parceremoni kommer en kille tvingas lämna Paradise Hotel – men klassen blir snart fulltalig igen. En återvändande utbytesstudent är redo att checka in, till vissas glädje och andras skräck.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 5
programme.desc: Skräcken och ångesten sprids som en löpeld bland deltagarna när de tvingas ta på sig skoluniformer och gå tillbaka till skolbänken. För att hålla ordning i klassen så checkar en ny lärarinna in.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 18
programme.desc: Innan finalparet koras har det blivit dags att stå till svars för sina synder i en sista grillning. Ett par kommer stå som segrare och göra upp om prissumman på en halv miljon kronor i kulceremonin!

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 5
programme.desc: De återstående paren vaknar med pirr i kroppen. Finalen är snart här! Men först väntar säsongens sista parceremoni.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 5
programme.desc: Vid frukosten får deltagarna ett brev där det står att det under dagen kommer bli ”Paradise Hotel Awards” där de ska förbereda en gala med prisutdelning för gamla deltagare som kommer tillbaka.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 5
programme.desc: Efter en dramatisk och lång säsong är det till slut dags att kora vinnarna av Paradise Hotel 2015.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 6
programme.desc: I en rosceremoni gör en av deltagarna ett högst oväntat val. Och i den allra sista parceremonin tvingas ytterligare en deltagare bort från hotellet och det står nu klart vilka som står i final.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 6
programme.desc: Finaldags i paradiset. Vilket par kommer vinna Paradise Hotel? Kan vinnarna verkligen lita på varandra eller kommer någon av dem att kasta kulan?

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 17
programme.desc: En vildhingst checkar in på hotellet, men vem av tjejerna i stallet kommer lyckas tämja honom? Pennorna vässas inför Pandoras Ask.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 17
programme.desc: Under Pandoras Ask blir det snabbt tydligt att det skaver rejält mellan deltagarna. Vänskap ifrågasätts och bakom fasaderna bubblar känslor som inte längre går att hålla tillbaka.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 17
programme.desc: Ytterligare en kejsarinna anländer till hotellet och hemligheter läcker ut, som sticker i vissa gästers ögon. I Pandoras Ask reder gästerna ut oklarheter och på festen bryter ett hetsigt bråk ut.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 18
programme.desc: En PH-Legend checkar in i kampen mot superskurkens planer – men vem spelar på vilken sida egentligen? Säsongens första pandoras ask väntar och skurkaktiga planer hotar att förstöra stämningen totalt!

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 18
programme.desc: Den hämndlystna ballerinan får utkräva sin hämnd direkt, frågan är bara på vem? Pandoras ask blir en skrikfest utan dess like och en av gästerna grillas lite extra.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 18
programme.desc: Säsongens sista pandoras ask står för dörren där somliga enbart har en tanka i huvudet: att sprida misstro hos dom andra! Under kvällen krossas både en stark vänskap och ett hoppfullt hjärta.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 5
programme.desc: Efter gårdagens bråk är stämningen tryckt vid frukostbordet. Allt blir bättre när tjejerna får veta att de ska träffa en spådam.

programme.title: Tornado
programme.desc: Hela TV-Serien i en förpackning! Hela 4 timmar och 49 minuter + 30 minuter extramaterial!!

programme.title: Bäst of Dag-Otto - innehåller filmerna
programme.desc: De roligaste ögonblicken med Dag-Otto från föreställningarna Snålvatten & Jäkelskap, Bröllop & Jäkelskap, Barnskrik & Jäkelskap, Brännvin & Fågelholkar och Solsting & Snesprång. Innehåller också nyinspelat material och musikvideos.

programme.title: Hajen som visste för mycket
programme.desc: Detta är en film om människor och pengar där huvudaktörernas huvuden huvudlöst förvrids i den desperata jakten på mammonkulor

programme.title: Top Gear: Avsnitt 5
programme.desc: Tom Cruise och Cameron Diaz är stjärnorna i Bil till Rimligt Pris, medan James May försöker slå sitt personliga fartrekord i en Bugatti Veyron.

programme.title: Top Gear
programme.desc: Teamet deltar i 24-timmarsloppet Britcar. Dessutom testar de Daihatsu Materia mot Ascari A10, och tävlar mot BMX-motorcyklister.

programme.title: Top Gear
programme.desc: I Amerika rymmer Top Gear-killarna iväg till den mexikanska gränsen i en Lexus LFA, en Dodge Viper och en Aston Martin Vanquish.

programme.title: Top Gear: Avsnitt 7
programme.desc: Lewis Hamilton gästar Top Gear-banan, och Jeremy och James besöker National Motor Museum för att hitta den moderna bilens verkliga ursprung.

programme.title: Top Gear: Avsnitt 1
programme.desc: Killarna är i Ryssland för att delta i ett otroligt lopp genom de vidsträckta och mycket vackra storstadslandskapen i Sankt Petersburg.

programme.title: Friday the 13th: The Series: Face Of Evil
programme.desc: The compact lost in the episode Vanity's Mirror is found by the dead girl's sister, but it gains a new curse.

programme.title: Friday the 13th: The Series: Read My Lips
programme.desc: Micki's college roommate wants her to be bridesmaid at her wedding. However, the woman's fiance, a ventriloquist, appears to be going insane.

programme.title: Friday the 13th: The Series: Hellowe'en
programme.desc: Micki and Ryan throw a Halloween party at the shop to meet the neighbours, but two visitors inadvertently resurrect Uncle Vendredi's spirit.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Knutsford Crown Court – Part 1
programme.desc: Derek Acorah’s The Past Hunters travel to Knutsford and investigate a former Crown Court. Multiple people have been sentenced to death and life in prison, but will the team encounter any of its former inmates tonight?

programme.title: Past Hunters: Knutsford Crown Court – Part 2
programme.desc: Derek Acorah’s The Past Hunters continue their investigation of Knutsford Crown Court. As they delve deeper into the building, will the ghosts and spirits make contact through Derek?

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: Situated near Kentucky's famous Mammoth Caves, the Grand Victorian Inn has carried the hopes of several businesses, residents, educators, and children since it was first erected in 1885. Now, its current owners have experienced a litany of ghostly claims.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: The team meets with a paranormal investigator who meticulously kept records on the town jail and has kept in contact with a variety of folks who worked there, including one of the location’s original jailers.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: Guests and employees of Hall Place have witnessed furniture moving on its own and apparitions of Civil War Union Soldiers ambling through the halls. The tunnels beneath were reportedly used for the underground railroad.

programme.title: Haunted Discoveries
programme.desc: The historic home of JP Speed has morphed into an Arts College, carrying on the legacy of the local entrepreneur’s second wife, Harriet, who was passionate about sharing her love for music and the humanities and is said to still be haunting the home.

programme.title: Nyfiken På
programme.desc: Denna gången är Rickard Olsson i Berlin tillsammans med Scandorama och deras gruppresa. Tillsammans med gruppen åker han på dagsutflykter till historiska platser men får även uppleva det nya Berlins mest populära och trendiga områden.

programme.title: Synd VA?
programme.desc: Hotellromantik paret Anneli och Thomas bjuder på lite knep för att elda på ett bra sexliv med kärleksspel.

programme.title: Nyfiken På
programme.desc: Följ med Rickard på en resa till Rostock för den perfekta julekänslan.

programme.title: Nyfiken På
programme.desc: Denna gången är det dags för att ta sig ned till Schweiz för att prova på att åka med den berömda Glaciärexpressen.

programme.title: Vanlife
programme.desc: Therese delar med sig av hur vädret på Sardinien påverkar vardagen i en van. Tommy utforskar ön på cykel när de tar sig vidare, och delar det fina med det oförutsägbara "vanlivet".

programme.title: Nyfiken På
programme.desc: Här åker Rickard Olsson ned med Springtime Travel för att testa på en av deras träningssresor.

programme.title: Fråga Experten
programme.desc: Ann Søderlund er på seniorfestivalen och pratar med Per Næsman om hur man hanterar testament.

programme.title: Nyfiken På
programme.desc: Denna gången befinner vi oss i Kroatien tillsammans med More Sailing som arrangerar seglingsresor över hela världen.

programme.title: Nyfiken På
programme.desc: Rickard tar sig med på en Whiskeyresa och tågresa till Skottland

programme.title: Nyfiken På
programme.desc: Rickard reser till storstaden London för att se vad den har att erbjuda. Följ med honom när han utforskar julmarknader, åker skridskor och besöker världsberömda platser.

programme.title: Vanlife
programme.desc: Therese lämnar sin trygga vardag och ger sig ut på sitt livs äventyr. Det visar sig bli en större inre utmaning än väntat. Hon delar med sig av insikter och lärdomar redan från början.

programme.title: Fråga Experten
programme.desc: Familjens Jurist svara på frågor om generationsskifte

programme.title: Nyfiken På
programme.desc: Här besöker Rickard Olsson, Almunécar. Han tar sig ut på kulturhistoriska platser såväl som världsberömda vingårdar eller träningsresor över hela världen. Missa inte den enda unika och skräddarsydda reseprogrammet för dig som är 55-plus.

programme.title: Vanlife
programme.desc: Therese bjuder in sin energifyllda vän Anna att bo "vanlife" med henne några dagar. Tillsammans utforskar de shopping, smaker och solnedgången i Puerto Banús.

programme.title: The Outer Limits
programme.desc: The last man on Earth living in an underground bunker has a computerized system takes care of his every need including providing holographic friends and relatives. Eventually the system, a female named Emma, demands to be loved.

programme.title: The Outer Limits
programme.desc: A mentally impaired janitor, Karl, is befriended by Dr. Valerian, a brilliant scientist who is dying of cancer. The older man decides that his various talents should not be allowed to die with him and convinces the young man to push the green button.

programme.title: The Outer Limits
programme.desc: Rebecca Highfield is impregnated by Dr. Lucy Cole with the cells of her dead child, which have been cloned from his brain.

programme.title: The Outer Limits
programme.desc: Danny Martin falls in love with Jade, a girl from college. When he brings her home for supper, his father recognizes her as the woman he saved from cruel experiments when he was a private in the army 20 years ago.

programme.title: The Outer Limits
programme.desc: When a virus starts killing people hooked up neurally to a worldwide information network, the only person who can stop it is a man unable to link into it due to a childhood injury.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn: The Series

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Nykomlingen Hettie Jago möter den erfarne förhandlaren David Harper. De två börjar i Skottland med 1 500 pund vardera och en Mercedes 280 SL från 1980-talet.

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Den andra etappen av Hettie Jago och David Harpers resa tar dem till Glasgow och Scottish Borders. Hettie har också ett nära möte med en ko medan hon forskar om John Boyd Orrs roll i utvecklingen av näringsläran.

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Idag är vi i Cumbria med Hettie Jago, David Harper och deras Mercedes 280 SL från 1980-talet. De tittar på en match i Workington och upptäcker en traditionell fotbollsmatch som kallas Uppies and Downies.

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Hettie Jago och David Harpers fjärde resa handlar om sjöarna, och de hoppas att deras Mercedes SL 280 cabriolet från 1980-talet kommer att klara de utmanande vägarna i distriktet. Hettie lär sig om en viktoriansk musikalisk pionjär.

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 706
programme.desc: Mie och Jakob har flyttat in hos Jakobs mamma för att spara ihop till sitt drömhus. Men finns deras drömhus ens på marknaden? Tobias argumenterar för sin sak och Mie och Jakob får sig en chock.

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 707
programme.desc: Både Kristina och Dennis familjer har flyttat till Odense och paret vill följa efter men kämpar att hitta tid för att gå på visningar. Vågar de satsa allt på experterna?

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 101
programme.desc: Värd Lisbeth Østergaard och de två experterna besöker Maiken och Michael i deras lilla lägenhet där de bor tillsammans med Michaels dotter. Snart blir de fyra och kan inte längre bo i lägenheten.

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 102
programme.desc: Vi besöker Jannie och René i deras lägenhet i centrala Esbjerg. Deras ettåriga dotter Alba sover i föräldrarnas sovrum och har inga utsikter att få ett eget rum.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Røros
programme.desc: Born as a mining town in the 17th century, Røros is now a center for local and organic food producers. Tareq tries dairy products which Michelin-starred chefs swear by, goes skiing and sledding around Røros many hilly streets

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Vimmerby
programme.desc: Vimmerby is known as the birthplace of beloved author Astrid Lindgren. Tareq finds that the area is also well-regarded for its cuisine. From the children’s theme park to the friendly moose that roam the hills, Vimmerby has a lot to offer visitors.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Trysil
programme.desc: The mountains and snowfall in Trysil mean that the town has to be creative with food; Tareq learns how to make cheese in the traditional way, and goes skiing of course, and takes to the slopes to cook something as skiers pass by.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Värmland
programme.desc: Värmland is home to many of Sweden’s most famous authors and inventors. However, it is also a place with a rich food culture. Tareq gets his hands on a very rare bird to cook and also takes time out to float down a tranquil river on a wooden raft.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Fyn
programme.desc: Tareq visits Fyn, the fairy tale capital of the world. Famous as the birthplace of Hans Christian Andersen, Fyn is also known as the garden of Denmark. Here we explore stunning nature and world class cuisine.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Höga Kusten
programme.desc: Created thousands of years ago, the High Coast in the northern part of Sweden is the highest coast in the world. Tareq sets out to sample one of the most extreme types of Swedish food, fermented herring.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: North Denmark
programme.desc: North Jutland has a rich culinary history. The unique conditions have created equally unique products. Tareq meets local food entrepreneurs who have learned to adapt to this ever changing environment and putting this region on the culinary map.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Uppsala
programme.desc: Uppsala is the city of knowledge: home to the oldest university in Scandinavia. It’s a wonderful agricultural area surrounded by fertile flatlands. Tareq discovers the historical treasures of Uppsala and its thriving culinary life.

programme.title: Geordie Shore
programme.desc: Gary blir svartsjuk när Marnie flirtar med den nya killen, Aaron. Alla blir glada när Vicky kommer tillbaka och de har sin första Tash-On Tours där geordisarna sätter sin egen tequila-dränkta prägel på singelkvällar.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: The Family's Reunited
programme.desc: Charlotte är tillbaka! Men hon kliver rakt in i en dubbeldejt och får reda på att Gary har fått ihop det med Marnie. Den nye killen Aaron lyckas få sin dejt med Holly, men avslöjar att han faktiskt är förtjust i Vicky.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Tash On Tours
programme.desc: Charlotte är tillbaka, så allas ögon är på Gaz och Marnie för att se om de kommer att sova ihop. Gänget åker till Manchester med Tash On Tours för att visa dem hur geordisar sköter en singelkväll - genom att supa och hångla.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: The New Boy
programme.desc: Det blir bråk när Aaron hör Vicky och tjejerna snacka skit om honom samma kväll som han ska gå på sin tredje dejt med Vicky. Och medan killarna jobbar får tjejerna en stor överraskning när en ny kille, Kyle, flyttar in i huset.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: A Trip To Iceland
programme.desc: Nykomlingen Kyle gör sig hemmastadd i huset genom att tillbringa natten med Holly, och Geordiegänget tar sin Tash On-turné till utlandet när de flyger till Reykjavik för att festa.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Marnie Exposes Gary
programme.desc: Efter att ha kollat in Islands killar, tjejer och gejsrar åker Geordiegänget hem, där det blir livat i luckan när Aaron och Scott får veta sanningen om Gary och Marnie, och Garys tvivelaktiga killkod.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Goin' South

programme.title: Secret War: The Special Interrogation Group
programme.desc: The SIG consisted of German speaking Jewish volunteers from Palestine. They had a highly dangerous job: which was to pose as Germans behind enemy lines and extract intelligence and do acts of sabotage. Few had a long-life expectancy.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: The Final Solution
programme.desc: This is the story of how Hitler orchestrated the genocide of 6 million Jews. Hitler portrayed Jews as a societal threat, using Goebbels' propaganda. Deportations were masked as resettlements while Auschwitz-Birkenau became a death factory.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Belgian Collaborator
programme.desc: Leon Degrelle, a charismatic Belgian leader, joined the Nazis and led Die Wallonien on the Eastern Front. Despite no military background, he earned the Knight's Cross for valor. He recruited 4000 more for the SS, defending Berlin until April 1945.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: Traitor-in-Chief
programme.desc: Pierre Laval, once celebrated and later reviled, faced execution in 1945 for collaboration with the Nazis during Vichy France. Originally a socialist and pacifist, he fell into collaboration for power and to navigate the horrors of occupation.

programme.title: The Hills: When You Least Expect It

programme.title: The Hills: The Best Night Ever
programme.desc: När Audrina objuden dyker upp på Heidis födelsedag blir hon snart varse om att Heidi inte är redo att förlåta henne. Lauren, fast besluten att koncentrera sig på jobbet, faller för en charmig ny kille i hennes liv - Brody.

programme.title: The Hills: Who Do You Trust?

programme.title: The Hills: One Big Interruption

programme.title: The Hills: You Have Chosen

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Äventyret fortsätter i North Yorkshire när Natasha och Ishy försöker vinna så många auktioner som möjligt med det som återstår av deras ursprungliga 1 500 pund.

programme.title: Antiques Road Trip
programme.desc: Halvvägs in på sin roadtrip letar Natasha och Ishy efter antikviteter i East Yorkshire. Förutom att köpa allt från en flapperklänning till en antik sittsäck och träffa några Highland-kor, lär sig Ishy om kusterosion.

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 103

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 104
programme.desc: Sonja och Emil bor tillsammans med deras ettåriga son Vilmer. De har själva renoverat lägenheten helt och hållet och det har varit så svårt att de inte orkar med en ny renovering.

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 105
programme.desc: Charlotte och Martin får besök av Lisbeth Østergaard och de två experterna i deras lägenhet. Charlotte har flyttat in i Martins lägenhet, men drömmer om att börja om på nytt och flytta in i ett hus.

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 201
programme.desc: Camilla Ottesen, fastighetsmäklaren Tobias Edlev Nielsen och arkitekten Mads Kappel Mikkelsen besöker Ida och Aske på Østerbro. De har letat efter en bostad i ett år, men har inte hittat drömhemmet.

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 202
programme.desc: Fastighetsmäklaren Tobias och arkitekten Mads får en svår uppgift när det gäller att hitta ett hus åt Lea och Sebastian från Brønshøj.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Uppsala
programme.desc: Uppsala is the city of knowledge: home to the oldest university in Scandinavia. It’s a wonderful agricultural area surrounded by fertile flatlands. Tareq discovers the historical treasures of Uppsala and its thriving culinary life.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: North Sealand
programme.desc: North Zealand has been a playground of the rich and famous since the fifteenth century. Tareq learns how this beautiful north eastern part of Denmark is the perfect place to go foraging for wild berries and herbs.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Åre
programme.desc: Sweden’s largest ski resort Åre is well known for its local ingredients, boasting the highest number of organic food producers per capita in Sweden. The fresh water and clean air create unique conditions for growing excellent food.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: The Danish Lakelands
programme.desc: The Danish Lakelands produce some of the finest ingredients that you can find. Tareq has a go at an old cooking technique from New Zealand called Hangi - using heated rocks buried in a pit oven.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: West Sweden
programme.desc: Gothenburg on the west coast of Sweden has recently been discovered as an exciting destination by both international travel journalists and food bloggers. Tareq tracks down an old army barracks which has been converted into a world class cheese factory.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Luleå
programme.desc: Tareq visits Luleå, home to the beautiful Tree Hotel: a collection of treehouses built by an award winning architect. Following the river further up into the mountains he reaches the land where, for centuries, the Sami people kept their reindeer herds.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Halmstad
programme.desc: In Halmstad Tareq explores the contrast between the busy summer scene at the beach and the quiet rural country life, meeting Jörgen Persson: award winning table tennis player and visiting a village famous for its cheese.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Kemi
programme.desc: Kemi is situated in northern Finland by the Bothnian Bay and it is part of Lapland region. Tareq tries his luck at a spot of burbot fishing on the frozen sea and visits the snow castle hotel.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Marnie Exposes Gary

programme.title: Geordie Shore: The New Boss

programme.title: Geordie Shore: A Party Gone Wrong

programme.title: Geordie Shore
programme.desc: Ooh la la! Gänget beger sig till Paris för ett jobb med Tash-On Tours, men kan Aaron förlåta Kyle för att han kysste Marnie? Vicky blir oprofessionellt stupfull på jobbet, och när de kommer hem åker Charlotte för att prata med pojkvännen.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Single Charlotte
programme.desc: Charlotte och Gary dras till varandra när hon återvänder efter besöket hos pojkvännen. Vicky kämpar med att få Marnie att ta jobbet på allvar och när det blir bråk kommer klorna fram.

programme.title: Geordie Shore

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Kissing Cousins
programme.desc: Snookis sexfyllda sommar gör sig påmind. Mike spelar Deena och Snooki det ultimata sprattet. Men de andra vännerna får sista skrattet och lämnar Mike eftersom har tar för lång tid på sig göra sig i ordning inför middagen.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride: Volkswagen Baja
programme.desc: I det här avsnittet pimpar teamet från West Coast Customs Krissys Volkswagen Baja Bug. Bubblan från 1969 konstruerades med hållbarhet som mål. Men med sitt böjda avgasrör och sina trasiga dörrar kan den verkligen beskrivas som allt annat än just det.

programme.title: Ridiculousness: The Potash Twins

programme.title: Hitler's Mega Plane: Hitler's Mega Plane
programme.desc: In January 2012, Italian divers discovered the wreck of a massive plane off the coast of Sardinia. At a depth of 65 meters (213 feet) lies a Messerschmidt “Gigant”.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: End Game
programme.desc: In January 1945, Nazi Germany faces defeat as Allied armies close in. Hitler, aged 55 and in poor health, remains defiant in his Berlin bunker. On April 30th, 1945, Hitler commits suicide, and days later, Germany surrenders, ending World War II.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: They are iconic weapons: the Tommy Gun, Uzi, and today’s MP5. Invented to break WWI stalemates, the submachine gun revolutionized warfare and culture. Host Wil Willis explores its evolution, firing the Thompson and BAR.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: The AK-47, the world's deadliest firearm, sparked a Cold War race for superior assault rifles like the American M4 and German HK 416. Host Wil Willis explores its history, from Mikhail Kalashnikov's WWII experiences to its assembly and lethal impact.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: The Misfits Gather
programme.desc: Hitler finds his political destiny in post-war Munich. He quickly dominates a fringe party & builds it into the Nazi Party. He recruits infamous men to the cause including Herman Goering & Heinrich Himmler & they plot a coup known as the Beerhall Putsch.

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook

programme.title: Casual Golf

programme.title: Casual Golf

programme.title: Casual Golf

programme.title: Husköp i blindo Danmark: Avsnitt 202

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Öland
programme.desc: Tareq bikes through the unique landscape of Öland, Sweden's second largest island located in the Baltic Sea. It is a place where the interaction between man and nature have created a diverse and rich farmland with an amazing amount of small producers.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Bornholm
programme.desc: Bornholm, the sunny bright green island with it’s own gastronomic tone is a true pioneer when it comes to local food at it’s finest quality. Tareq visit Denmark's first regional food culture house where they develop this unique flourishing cuisine.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Laponia
programme.desc: In the northern part of Sweden, you’ll find the stunning world heritage Laponia. Almost 10.000 square kilometres of nature reserves and national parks. Tareq visit the rich, unique culture of the sami in the vast impressive wilderness.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Malmö & Copenhagen
programme.desc: Tareq Taylor returns to his home turf to see what has happened and what the future might bring to the new nordic cuisine. He visits a local goat farmer and meets up with young enthusiastic chefs who takes this nordic legacy further.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Zealand
programme.desc: Tareq Taylor visits the South Coast of Denmark to make his own versions of open-faced sandwiches and smoked fish dishes.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Dalsland
programme.desc: Tareq Taylor puts on his hiking boots and explores the pilgrim trail of Dalsland in West Sweden. This episode will include outdoor cooking, foraging and beaver safari.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Stockholm
programme.desc: When Tareq arrives in Stockholm he will meet innovation and world class gastronomy, a big city for foodies. He will make some pizza at the Rosendal garden café and go on an adventure in the archipielago.

programme.title: Tareq Taylor's Nordic Cookery: Lolland
programme.desc: When Michelin star chefs move from Copenhagen to the countryside, they often end up in Lolland/Falster. Here Tareq will meet Claus Meyer the father of new nordic cuisine and other entrepreneurs that opened interesting restaurants here.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: The Misfits Gather
programme.desc: Hitler finds his political destiny in post-war Munich. He quickly dominates a fringe party & builds it into the Nazi Party. He recruits infamous men to the cause including Herman Goering & Heinrich Himmler & they plot a coup known as the Beerhall Putsch.

programme.title: Secret War: The SAS Italian Job
programme.desc: In 1945, during the Italian Spring offensive, SOE agent Michael Lees and SAS officer Roy Farran led a raid on German HQs at Villa Rossi and Villa Calvi. Despite orders to cancel, Farran attacked with SAS men and partisans, killing many Germans.

programme.title: Secret War: Hardy Amies and Operation Ratweek
programme.desc: Operation Ratweek’s existence has always been denied. However WMR has now discovered evidence that it existed and was carried out.

programme.title: Secret War: Double Agent Tricycle
programme.desc: Dusan Popov was almost certainly James Bond. Ian Fleming knew all the stories about him. Popov managed to persuade both the Germans and MI6 to keep him in the style of a millionaire businessman while performing a series of missions against the Nazis.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Dutch Collaborator
programme.desc: Anton Adriaan Mussert, initially resisted Hitler’s anti-Semitism despite modeling his NSB party, even welcoming Jewish members. His failed attempt to kidnap Queen Wilhelmina led him into hiding, after which he collaborated in hopes of gaining power.

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: When Mengqi Ji vanished, her husband claimed she walked out on him. But cell phone data, muddy boots, and a juniper tree in a state park told a very different story. A solved true crime case about control, lies, and justice.

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook
programme.desc: In November 1993, 19-year-old college student Wanda Musk was abducted at knifepoint from her gas station job in Flint, Michigan, and beaten to death. DNA from a prisoner law finally solved the case in 2013.

programme.title: Mollie Westbrook
programme.desc: In January 2018, 19-year-old gay college student Blaze Bernstein was lured to a California park by former classmate Samuel Woodward, who stabbed him 28 times. Woodward was convicted of hate crime murder in 2024.

programme.title: Gabulosis: The John Doe in the Grand Canyon Garage: The Haunting Mystery of The Kolb Skeleton
programme.desc: In 1977, a human skeleton dating back to 1933 was found hidden in the rafters of famed photographer Emery Kolb's garage at the Grand Canyon. Its identity remains unknown to this day.

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: A doctor is gunned down on the Ohio Turnpike in what looks like a random robbery. His grieving wife told a convincing story until investigators proved she ordered the hit. A solved true crime case that is brutal, calculated, and deeply personal.

programme.title: Rachel Shannon True Crime
programme.desc: A Coast Guard mother's baby is found dead in her crib in Alaska. What looked like SIDS turned into a criminal case built on a coerced confession, so the conviction fell apart in court. A true crime case full of unanswered questions.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel, säsong 18

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge
programme.desc: Arild blandar ihop sin privatekonomi med sitt företag och har därför tappat kontrollen. Han har skulder på långt över en miljon kronor. Arild är en skicklig tatuerare, men hur kan han rädda sin ekonomi?

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge
programme.desc: Hilde slösar bort sin lön som lastbilschaufför på sitt bilintresse. Hon struntar i räkningarna, kylskåpet är tomt, elen är på väg att stängas av och skulderna växer.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge
programme.desc: Ellinor har sålt sitt hus och är på väg att starta om sitt liv. Trots en bra inkomst har hon det kämpigt. Experterna följer med henne under flyttprocessen och blir chockade över hur mycket pengar som läggs på onödiga inköp.

programme.title: Harlequin: Treacherous Beauties

programme.title: Harlequin: Broken Lullaby

programme.title: Harlequin: The Awakening
programme.desc: När en prisjägare, som spårar en av hennes hyresgäster, övertygar Sara McAllister att samarbeta med honom, påbörjar de ett äventyr tillsammans i den farliga världen av internationell spionage och kärlek. Denna film visas utan svenska undertexter.

programme.title: Dating Naked UK
programme.desc: Ännu en naken nybörjare kommer och blir en stor prövning för ett par. Samtidigt känner sig de utan starka kontakter också sårbara.

programme.title: The Pride of the Yankees
programme.desc: The story of the life and career of famed baseball player Lou Gehrig.

programme.title: The Misfits
programme.desc: In their final screen performances, Clark Gable and Marilyn Monroe are at their luminous best as an aging cowboy and a disillusioned divorcee, each trying to adapt to new ways of life in John Huston's piercing classic. Montgomery Clift also stars.

programme.title: The Seven Year Itch
programme.desc: With his family away for their annual summer holiday, New Yorker Richard Sherman (Tom Ewell) decides he has the opportunity to live a bachelor's life. The beautiful but ditzy blonde (Marilyn Monroe) from the apartment above him catches his eye.

programme.title: Some Like It Hot
programme.desc: This hysterical comedy from director Billy Wilder finds Tony Curtis and Jack Lemmon masquerading as women in order to elude irate Chicago mobsters while befriending a beautiful singer (Marilyn Monroe).

programme.title: Point Break
programme.desc: An F.B.I. Agent goes undercover to catch a gang of surfers who may be bank robbers.

programme.title: Olympus Has Fallen
programme.desc: Secret Service agent Mike Banning finds himself trapped inside the White House in the wake of a terrorist attack and works to rescue the President from his kidnappers.

programme.title: Shooter
programme.desc: Determined to prove his innocence in a double-cross, Bob Lee Swagger is now in a high-tension race from every law enforcement agency in the US and a shadowy organization that wants him dead.

programme.title: Friday the 13th
programme.desc: Camp Crystal Lake has been shuttered for over 20 years due to several vicious and unsolved murders. The camp's new owner and seven young counselors are preparing the property for reopening despite warnings from residents about a "death curse."

programme.title: Friday the 13th Part II
programme.desc: Five years after the bloodbath at Camp Crystal, all that remains is the legend of Jason and his demented mother, who had murdered seven camp counselors. At a nearby summer camp, the new counselors are unconcerned about the warnings to stay away.

programme.title: Friday the 13th - Part III
programme.desc: Ignoring Camp Crystal Lake’s bloody legacy, one by one they fall victim to the maniacal Jason who stalks them at every turn...

programme.title: Friday the 13th Part - IV: The Final Chapter
programme.desc: After his revival in a hospital morgue, the hockey-masked murderer fixes his vengeful attention on the Jarvis family and a group of hitherto carefree teenagers.

programme.title: Head of State
programme.desc: When Washington desperately needs a presidential candidate just weeks before the election, they need someone sure to lose. They pick Mays Gilliam (Chris Rock), an unknown local politician from a down-and-out D.C. neighborhood, to be their puppet.

programme.title: Coming to America
programme.desc: Join EDDIE MURPHY on an unforgettable comic quest to the New World. As an African Prince, it's time for him to find a princess. The mission leads him and his most loyal friend (ARSENIO HALL) to New York. Watch Murphy and Hall in classic cameo roles!

programme.title: Don't Tell Mom the Babysitter's Dead (2024)
programme.desc: Tanya finds her summer plans canceled when her mom jets off for a last-minute retreat, and the elderly babysitter who arrives at her door unexpectedly passes away.

programme.title: Lionheart
programme.desc: Jean-Claude Van Damme is Lyon Gaultier, a deserter in the French Foreign Legion who travels to the USA and enters the gory world of bare-knuckled street fighting in order to make money to save his brother's life and family.

programme.title: Double Impact
programme.desc: Identical twins are separated at six months and raised on different continents. They reunite twenty-five years later to avenge the murder of their parents and reclaim their stolen family fortune.

programme.title: Universal Soldier
programme.desc: A woman reporter discovers a Defense Department project to create androids from the bodies of Vietnamese soldiers, to be then used as an elite anti-terrorism unit.

programme.title: Dodgeball: A True Underdog Story
programme.desc: Dodgeball is back, and this time it’s not just for the schoolyard.

programme.title: Caddyshack
programme.desc: It's the snobs against the slobs! While caddy Danny tries to impress elitist Judge Smails, a crude construction tycoon tries to get accepted at the country club, and a groundskeeper stalks a gopher.

programme.title: Little Nicky
programme.desc: When Satan reneges on his plans to retire, two of his three heirs leave Hell to gather enough souls to vote the Prince of Darkness out of office. But Satan sends his youngest—and nicest—son, Little Nicky, to bring the other two home.

programme.title: It Had to Be You
programme.desc: Two strangers meet and fall in love during the weekend that they are planning their respective weddings.

programme.title: The Pallbearer
programme.desc: Nothing like death to put some life into romance: a hapless 25-year-old's fortunes change when he is a pallbearer for someone he doesn't know. David Schwimmer, Gwyneth Paltrow.

programme.title: Kate & Leopold
programme.desc: When a rip in time brings together a charming 19th-century bachelor and a thoroughly 21st-century woman, the potential for an old-fashioned modern romance ignites!

programme.title: The Gift
programme.desc: Widow and mother of three, Annie Wilson makes her living by foretelling others' futures...though her own has become cloudier than even she can see.

programme.title: Coherence
programme.desc: In this mind-bending sci-fi thriller, 8 friends at a dinner party start experiencing strange and mysterious events on the night a comet is passing close to Earth. Soon it becomes clear that nothing and no one are what they appear.

programme.title: The Silence of the Lambs
programme.desc: An FBI trainee is assigned by her superior to interview an imprisoned, cannibalistic psychopath, Hannibal the Cannibal Lecter, in the hope that he may help uncover the identity of an elusive serial killer.

programme.title: The Yards
programme.desc: After being released from prison, Leo Handler (Mark Wahlberg) takes a job with his powerfully influential Uncle Frank (James Caan). Leo soon finds himself unwittingly drawn into a world of sabotage, high-stakes payoffs and even murder.

programme.title: We Own the Night
programme.desc: What if your own family stood in the way of everything you worked for? Bobby Green (Joaquin Phoenix) has forsaken his name to escape his family and their tradition in law enforcement to pursue his ambitions as a Brooklyn nightclub owner. Rated R

programme.title: The Master (2012)
programme.desc: Haunted by his past, WW-II veteran and drifter Freddie Quell (Joaquin Phoenix) crosses paths with a mysterious movement led by The Master (Phillip Seymour Hoffman) and his wife (Amy Adams).

programme.title: Outlaws and Angels
programme.desc: When Outlaws on the lam invade the home of an unsuspecting, seemingly innocent frontier family to hide out for the night, an unexpected game of cat and mouse ensues, leading to seduction, role reversal, and ultimately, bloody revenge.

programme.title: No Country For Old Men
programme.desc: Winner of four Academy Awards, including Best Picture, filmmakers Joel and Ethan Coen (FARGO) bring to the screen a thrilling bestseller in which a crime-scene's irresistible stolen loot sets forth an unstoppable chain reaction of violence.

programme.title: Brimstone
programme.desc: A triumphant thriller set in the menacing inferno of the old American West, Brimstone tells the story of Liz, a genuine survivor who is hunted by a vengeful Preacher for a crime she didn’t commit.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
programme.desc: When New York City is in trouble, it’s up to the four ninja-fighting, pizza-loving brothers to save it. Aided by determined reporter April O’Neil and their wise master Splinter, these unlikely heroes must face their ultimate nemesis - the evil Shredder.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Out of the Shadows
programme.desc: The Turtles are back to battle a bigger threat alongside April O'Neil and vigilante Casey Jones. As they prepare to take on supervillain Shredder and his henchmen, Bebop and Rocksteady, they find themselves facing an even greater evil: the sinister Krang.

programme.title: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Air, Water, Earth, Fire. Four nations are tied by destiny when Fire launches war against the others. Caught between the war, one Avatar discovers he's able to manipulate all four elements.

programme.title: Zodiac
programme.desc: Based on the Robert Graysmith books about the real-life notorious Zodiac, a serial killer who terrorized San Francisco with a string of seemingly random murders during the 1960s and 1970s.

programme.title: Pet Sematary (1989)
programme.desc: For most families, moving is a new beginning. But for the Creeds, it could be the beginning of the end because they've just moved in next door to a place that children built with broken dreams, the Pet Sematary.

programme.title: Cujo
programme.desc: While Donna and Vic Trenton struggle to save their rocky marriage, their son Tad befriends the loveable 200-lb St. Bernard who belongs to their mechanic.

programme.title: Maximum Overdrive
programme.desc: After a mysterious comet turns every machine on Earth into a homicidal rampage device, the survivors at the Dixie Boy Truck Stop are making a stand, and human vengeance goes into overdrive.

programme.title: The Slumber Party Massacre
programme.desc: When Trish (Michele Michaels) decides to invite her high school girls' basketball teammates over for a slumber party, she has no idea the night is going to end with an unexpected guest.

programme.title: April Fool's Day
programme.desc: When Muffy St. John invited her college friends up to her parents’ secluded island home for the time of their lives, she just forgot to tell them it might be the last time of their lives.

programme.title: Scream
programme.desc: After a series of mysterious deaths, an offbeat group of scary movie fans becomes the target of a masked killer in this smash-hit thriller from legendary director Wes Craven (A NIGHTMARE ON ELM STREET) that breathed new life into the horror genre.

programme.title: Scream 2
programme.desc: While away at college, Sidney Prescott thought she'd finally put the terror behind her...until a copycat killer begins acting out a real-life sequel in which no one is safe, or beyond suspicion.

programme.title: Scream 3
programme.desc: The first film set the rules. In the sequel, the stakes got higher. In the third installment of the hit franchise SCREAM, all bets are off. It's an insidious game of horror movie mayhem with surprising twists and turns.

programme.title: Footloose
programme.desc: A rebellious city boy finds himself in an uptight Midwestern town where dancing and, therefore, all youthful joy have been banned.

programme.title: Fatal Attraction
programme.desc: Michael Douglas plays Dan, a New York attorney who has a tryst with seductive Alex Forrest while his wife is away. Dan later shrugs off the affair as a mistake and considers it over. But Alex won't be ignored. Not now, not tomorrow, not ever.

programme.title: Overboard
programme.desc: A wealthy woman hires a carpenter to work on her yacht. When the carpenter is left unpaid, Joanna, sets sail. The following day, Joanna's fished out of the sea after falling overboard and diagnosed with amnesia.

programme.title: A Night at the Roxbury
programme.desc: It seems like Steve and Doug will never be cool enough to make the Roxbury club’s guest list. Until they have a fender bender with their role model, club regular Richard Grieco. Eager to avoid litigation, Grieco befriends the starstruck pair.

programme.title: The Brady Bunch Movie
programme.desc: Mike and Carol have just one week to come up with $20,000 in back taxes, or they’ll lose their house to a neighbor. Even worse, Marcia gets a swollen nose on date night, Cindy’s addicted to tattling, and Jan’s hearing a psychotic inner voice.

programme.title: Wayne's World
programme.desc: When a sleazy TV exec offers Wayne and Garth a contract to tape their late-night cable-access show at his network, they discover the road to the big time is full of gnarly twists and turns.

programme.title: Hoodlum
programme.desc: 1930's New York. The black community of Harlem faces the same indignities as countless millions of refugees. If the seeds of Harlem's urban power would not grow in the White city, the Black underground would form to take control.

programme.title: To Live And Die In L.A.
programme.desc: Federal agent Richard Chance has a score to settle, and he's through playing by the rules. He vows to take down a murderous counterfeiter by any means necessary. But as the stakes grow higher, will Chance's obsession ultimately destroy him?

programme.title: Widows
programme.desc: When four armed robbers are killed, their widows take fate into their own hands.

programme.title: Juice
programme.desc: Q. Raheem. Bishop. Steel. They're four Harlem friends who spend their days hanging out and looking for a way to get the power and respect they call Juice. Q hopes to earn respect by becoming a scratch 'n' mix DJ.

programme.title: Beast Of Burden
programme.desc: Sean Haggerty only has an hour to deliver his illegal cargo. An hour to reassure a drug cartel, a hitman, and the DEA that nothing is wrong. An hour to make sure his wife survives. And he must do it all from the cockpit of his Cessna.

programme.title: Guns Akimbo
programme.desc: A guy relies on his newly acquired gladiator skills to save his ex-girlfriend from kidnappers.

programme.title: Escape From Pretoria
programme.desc: Based on the real-life prison break of two political captives, Escape from Pretoria is a race-against-time thriller set in the tumultuous apartheid days of South Africa.

programme.title: So I Married an Axe Murderer
programme.desc: Comedy sensation Mike Myers stars with Nancy Travis in this hatchet-driven romantic comedy about a wedlock-shy coffee house poet who finally meets the perfect woman. Rated: PG-13

programme.title: That Thing You Do!
programme.desc: Are you ready to rock n' roll? The Wonders are here to take you back to a simpler time when being famous was a bit more innocent.

programme.title: Swingers
programme.desc: In this laugh-out-loud indie comedy classic that launched the careers of its outstanding cast, two friends set out to rewrite modern dating from Los Angeles to Las Vegas.

programme.title: The Mechanic
programme.desc: In a role that powered him to stardom, Charles Bronson is an underworld executioner who turns murder into an art form in this ultimate crime chiller.

programme.title: Gone In 60 Seconds
programme.desc: Buckle-up as Eleanor, the fast and furious Ford Fastback Mustang, takes you on a full-throttle ride you'll never forget. The Assignment: To steal 48 muscle and exotic cars! The Challenge: Avoid getting caught!

programme.title: Serpico
programme.desc: A true-life drama of a cop whose revelations about the extent of bribery in the New York Police Department almost led to his death and resulted in the creation of the Knapp Commission.

programme.title: Three Days of the Condor
programme.desc: A mild-mannered CIA researcher, paid to read books, returns from lunch to find all of his co-workers assassinated. "Condor" must find out who did this and get in from the cold before the hitmen get him.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn
programme.desc: In this thrilling cult classic, two dangerous outlaw brothers head out on a wild crime spree. After kidnapping a father and his two kids, the bad guys head to a seedy Mexican bar for safety, but come face to face with blood-sucking vampires.

programme.title: Mimic
programme.desc: From Oscar-winning director Guillermo del Toro (THE SHAPE OF WATER) comes the ultimate battle between man and nature. Once a miracle of genetic engineering, what was created in the lab has evolved to mimic the most dangerous predator of all—humans.

programme.title: Mimic 2
programme.desc: Four years after a terrifying mutation took New York City by surprise, a detective stumbles upon a link between the "mimic" creatures and three grisly new murder victims. The shape-shifting bugs are back.

programme.title: Eurotrip
programme.desc: Europe will never be the same again after Scotty Thomas and his buddies take off for the express to excess! They're hooking up with hot strangers and jamming all the extreme insanity they can into the wildest trip of their lives!

programme.title: Scary Movie
programme.desc: The spoof that started it all. Scream with the Wayans brothers, Carmen Electra, Shannon Elizabeth, and Anna Faris as they bumble and shriek their way to horror-movie hilarity in Scary Movie.

programme.title: Scary Movie 2
programme.desc: Four teens are tricked by their professor into visiting a haunted house for a school project.

programme.title: Power Rangers
programme.desc: A group of high-school students, who are infused with unique superpowers, harness their abilities in order to save the world.

programme.title: The Perks of Being a Wallflower
programme.desc: Socially awkward Charlie is a wallflower watching from the sidelines, until a pair of charismatic seniors take him under their wing.

programme.title: Warm Bodies
programme.desc: After a highly unusual zombie saves a still-living girl from an attack, the two form a relationship that sets in motion events that might transform the entire lifeless world.

programme.title: Runaway Bride
programme.desc: Julia Roberts plays a small-town girl whose marches down the aisle become a series of near Mrs. when she bolts before saying "I do."

programme.title: Mona Lisa Smile
programme.desc: Julia Roberts stars as a novice art history professor with a surprising lesson plan that inspires her students to open their eyes to love and life.

programme.title: The Mexican
programme.desc: A man tries to transport an ancient gun called The Mexican, believed to carry a curse, back across the border, while his girlfriend pressures him to give up his criminal ways.

programme.title: Top Five
programme.desc: Written, directed and starring Chris Rock, TOP FIVE tells the story of New York City comedian-turned-film star Andre Allen, whose unexpected encounter with a journalist forces him to confront the comedy career—and the past—that he’s left behind.

programme.title: The Players Club
programme.desc: A single mom tries to work her way through college, moonlighting as an exotic dancer.

programme.title: Nobody's Fool (2018)
programme.desc: Tiffany Haddish is hysterical in Tyler Perry's most outrageous comedy yet. Wild child Tanya looks to her buttoned-up sister Danica to get back on her feet. As these opposites collide, Tanya learns that Danica's perfect life may not be what it seems.

programme.title: 10 Cloverfield Lane
programme.desc: After a car crash, a woman wakes up in a survivalist's bunker. He claims to have saved her from an apocalyptic attack, but, growing suspicious of his motives, she'll have to escape to discover the truth.

programme.title: Shutter Island
programme.desc: When U.S. Marshal Teddy Daniels arrives at the asylum for the criminally insane on Shutter Island, he uncovers terrifying truths about the island. He finds out that some places never let you go.

programme.title: Overlord
programme.desc: Nothing can prepare you for the mind-blowing mayhem that is Overlord. Mega producer J.J. Abrams creates an insanely twisted thrill ride about a team of American troops who come face-to-face with Nazi super-soldiers unlike the world has ever seen.

programme.title: Rocky III
programme.desc: Rocky Balboa (Sylvester Stallone) battles his most powerful adversary yet, Clubber Lang (Mr. T), in this hard-hitting actioner that comes out swinging as Rocky strives to regain the 'eye of the tiger' after a humiliating defeat in the ring.

programme.title: Rocky IV
programme.desc: East meets West when Rocky (Sylvester Stallone) takes on a vicious Soviet fighter (Dolph Lundgren) with a deadly punch in a match that means not only defending himself, but also defending the honor of his country and the memory of an old friend.

programme.title: Rocky V
programme.desc: Broke and injured after his bout with Russian powerhouse Ivan Drago, Rocky Balboa (Sylvester Stallone) must rediscover his roots in this thrill-packed drama that reunites Stallone with John G. Avildsen, the Oscar®-winning director of 'Rocky.'

programme.title: 48 Hrs.
programme.desc: Nolte is a rough-edged cop after two vicious cop-killers. He can't do it without the help of smooth Murphy, who is serving time for a half-million-dollar robbery.

programme.title: Another 48 Hrs.
programme.desc: Times may change…but these guys don’t! Eddie Murphy and Nick Nolte are back on the streets in this smash sequel.

programme.title: Trading Places
programme.desc: The story of a down-and-out con artist who trades lifestyles with a well-to-do investor.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull
programme.desc: STEVEN SPIELBERG and GEORGE LUCAS present Indiana Jones and the Kingdom of the Crystal Skull. Join Indy as he races against a brilliant and beautiful agent for the mystical, all-powerful crystal skull of Akator in this thrilling adventure!

programme.title: Raiders of the Lost Ark
programme.desc: Get ready for thrills in Indiana Jones and the Raiders of the Lost Ark. Indy and his ex-flame Marion Ravenwood dodge booby-traps, fight Nazis, and stare down snakes in their incredible worldwide quest for the mystical Ark of the Covenant.

programme.title: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom
programme.desc: Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom brings you thrills and excitement. Indy, his sidekick Short Round, and nightclub singer Willie Scott go from high-flying action above the Himalayas to a spine-tingling escape from a fortress-like mine in India.

programme.title: House of Gucci
programme.desc: Inspired by the true story of the family behind the Italian fashion empire. When Patrizia Reggiani marries into the Gucci family, her unbridled ambition begins to unravel the family legacy and triggers a spiral of betrayal, decadence, and murder.

programme.title: Sumotherhood
programme.desc: This British crime comedy sees two hapless friends run into trouble after an attempted bank robbery goes wrong.

programme.title: Prey for the Devil
programme.desc: With cases of demonic possession at an all-time high, the first female exorcist is called to save the soul of a young girl. But who, or what, has invited her?

programme.title: The MST3K Yule Log
programme.desc: Get into the holiday spirit with The MST3K Yule Log!

programme.title: MST3K: The Undead
programme.desc: A woman gets hypnotized back into her Dark Age'd past life while Tom takes a crack at being an observer.

programme.title: MST3K: Killer Fish
programme.desc: In part five of a Gauntlet six-movie binge, Jonah and the bots take on the 1979 film Killer Fish.

programme.desc: Hits on the playlist include "Sour Times," "Reach for the Sky" and "Check It Out."

programme.desc: Wicked questions meet wicked fails in this autumnal mash-up of mess-ups.

programme.desc: Showing an all-out scream fest - where every shriek, scare and supernatural surprise takes center stage.

programme.title: FailFactory

programme.title: Fail-O-Ween

programme.desc: Gravity, inertia, and buoyancy team up to take humans down - spectacularly.

programme.desc: Greg Davies returns as the Taskmaster as five new comedic competitors tackle a raft of tricky tasks with today's episode including a potato-throwing moment set to make television and sporting history.
